data.body: Post-merge disposable verification PASS. Both pre-rewrite and publication-faithful post-rewrite scans used the merged verifier fix and their mapped boundaries. Each reported exactly 8,746 verified, 949 unsigned, 0 unknown-author, 180 bad-signature, 0 key-not-valid-at-era across 9,875 in-scope events. Their normalized 1,129-item (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets are exactly equal. The earlier 18 era results belonged to the pre-fix baseline and correctly disappear on both sides. Gerrit 1396 landed as d33ec772590d42229d5ad1dec003da65da1fa56e with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments.
